newsitem.title: USA: United Tech Q1 net boosted by Pratt, Otis.
newsitem.headline: United Tech Q1 net boosted by Pratt, Otis.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said Wednesday that first quarter income was boosted by strong operating profit growth at its Pratt, Otis, and Carrier units, but operating profit declined at its Automotive unit.
Earlier, United reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.86 a share versus $0.62 a share a year ago. The First Call analysts' consensus was $0.80 for this year's first quarter.
Foreign currency translation cut 1997 first quarter revenues by $138 million and earnings per share by $0.03, United said.

United said operating profit at its Pratt and Whitney unit improved 30 percent, reflecting continued productivity improvements, higher aftermarket sales, and increased military and commercial engine shipments, partially offset by higher research and development spending.

Its flight systems' unit operating profit increased 41 percent due to higher revenues and operating profit at Sikorsky as well as Hamilton Standard. United said its elevator unit, Otis, saw a 12 percent rise in operating profit driven by improvement in Europe and the Americas.

Its air conditioner unit, Carrier, posted 27 percent operating profit improvement reflecting higher profit in North America, offset partially by weakness in Europe and in transportation refrigeration.
United said its automotive unit's operating profit declined primarily due to continued weakness in the Interiors business and customer pricing pressures.
